audience: Urbeno Operations Managers who acknowledge requests, manage vehicles and weighments, and run reports

steps.title: Step 1 — Sign in as Operations Manager
steps.howTo:
1. Open https://tectrack.urbeno.in in Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
2. Enter your @urbeno.in email from the account notification.
3. Enter your password and click Sign In.
4. Complete MFA if enrolled (staff MFA applies to Operations).
5. Accept Terms and Privacy on first login if prompted; set a new password if must-reset is required.
steps.tips: Operations accounts are Urbeno-only. Never share MFA codes. Contact info@urbeno.in if locked out.

steps.title: Step 2 — Operations dashboard
steps.howTo:
1. Land on the Operations Dashboard.
2. Review open requests, KPIs, and shortcuts into the queue.
3. Confirm navigation: Dashboard, Requests, Recycling Heroes, Sustainability, Capacity, Reports.
4. Confirm you do NOT see Masters, Audit, or Compliance (those are Super Admin / Auditor areas).
steps.tips: You see all client organisations. Treat data as confidential.

steps.title: Step 3 — Work the requests queue
steps.howTo:
1. Open Requests.
2. Filter for Stage 1 / New items awaiting acknowledgement.
3. Open a request, then Acknowledge or Request changes with a clear note.
4. After acknowledgement, Assign Vehicle when ready (registration, driver, phone).
5. Record weighment with slip photo and pickup photo; confirm net = gross − tare.
steps.tips: You typically do not raise invoices, create MRN, issue Form 6, or upload CoD — hand those to Super Admin / Factory as designed.

steps.title: Step 4 — Lifecycle actions in your scope
steps.howTo:
1. On request detail, read the stage badge and header.
2. Stage 1: Acknowledge or Request changes.
3. Stage 3: Assign / edit vehicles in your permission set.
4. Stage 4: Complete weighment with required photos.
5. Refresh as Factory and Super Admin advance MRN, Form 6, and CoD.
6. Use Queries only if your account has manage-queries (usually Super Admin).
steps.tips: If a button is missing, that action is outside Operations Manager permissions — escalate to Super Admin.

steps.title: Step 5 — Capacity view
steps.howTo:
1. Open Capacity.
2. Review authorised category utilisation across factories.
3. Note any near-limit categories for planning pickups.
steps.tips: Capacity is read-focused for Operations; category master edits are Super Admin.

steps.title: Step 6 — Reports and exports
steps.howTo:
1. Open Reports.
2. Run Request Summary, Complete Request Summary, Invoice Register, Sustainability, Heroes, Serials as needed.
3. Set FY / period filters.
4. Export CSV or PDF when available.
steps.tips: Exports may contain multi-client data — store securely.

steps.title: Step 7 — Recycling Heroes
steps.howTo:
1. Open Recycling Heroes.
2. Review organisation tonnage and planting milestones.
3. Use period filters to prepare client updates.
steps.tips: Planting admin controls (if any) may be Super Admin only.

steps.title: Step 8 — Profile, password, and MFA
steps.howTo:
1. Open Profile.
2. Confirm Role is Operations Manager.
3. Change password using the policy (length + complexity).
4. Enrol or manage MFA within the grace window if prompted.
steps.tips: After the MFA grace period, staff must enrol before continuing.

steps.title: Step 9 — Sign out safely
steps.howTo:
1. Open the account menu.
2. Click Sign out.
3. Confirm you return to the login screen.
steps.tips: Always sign out on shared devices.
